correctness.rationale: For s,r>=1 and split E=⊕_{j=0}^t O_{P^s}(b_j)^{m_j}, b_0=0<b_1<...<b_t, lines convention: (i) evaluation at any base point of degree-increasing bundle maps is surjective and diagonal GL(m_j) plus those shears acts transitively on the minimum-nonzero-degree stratum; base PGL transitivity lifts. (ii) For t>0 the nef rays are H and D=xi+b_t H; H contracts P^r fibres whereas |D| is generically injective on the locus with nonzero degree-zero coordinate (Veronese degree b_t recovers base, remaining sections recover fibre). Thus full Aut preserves the unique fibre-type contraction and acts by E≅g*E⊗L; the finite splitting-degree multiset forces L trivial and triangularity forces preservation of all F_j. (iii) A line over a chosen lowest nonzero level is the graph of ℓ→⊕_{h>j}O(b_h)^{m_h}, so U_j=Tot(⊕_{h>j}O(b_h-b_j)⊠O_{P^{m_j-1}}(1)^{m_h}) over P^s×P^{m_j-1}. (iv) Closure P(F_j) has codimension Σ_{h<j}m_h, vector bundle multiplicativity gives the exact motive; the boundary P(F_1) has codimension m0. Product t=0 and Hirzebruch / threefold edge cases agree. Finite census does not prove (i)–(ii).
